02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Behind the code,
a curious human.

Hey, I’m Nathaniel ↗

I’m a final-year Computer Science student at RMIT University in Melbourne. I enjoy taking an idea, figuring out how it could work, and building something people can actually use.

My projects span full-stack web development, AI, data, and mixed reality. I like working through the whole process — shaping the idea, writing the code, testing it, and getting it out into the world.

Hackathons are one of my favourite ways to learn. I love meeting other builders, trying unfamiliar tools, and seeing how far a small idea can go.
